title: Codeyaan - Learning Management System
description: Codeyaan LMS is an enterprise-grade full-stack learning management system built using Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. Designed with a microservices architecture, it includes secure JWT authentication, role-based access control, API Gateway, rate limiting, centralized logging (Winston), and scalable REST APIs. The platform is optimized for cloud deployment, high availability, and performance.

title: HoliVibes - Holi Festival Web App
description: Built a dynamic Holi greeting web app with Next.js and Tailwind CSS featuring animated gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism UI, and interactive color burst animations using Framer Motion.

title: TMS: Task Management System
